answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by bonding influence: at the dawn of each epoch every voter locks a stake. A sybil farm must post one bond per fake identity, so its cost rises linearly with clone count while honest voters share one real stake. Auditors sample ballots cheaply and slash fraud, burning that bond. Cheap checks against expensive, forfeitable deposits make cloning unprofitable, so fake identities drain like rain through karst and trusted ivory status stays scarce.
